occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The operation has been recited for the same two deficiencies more than once: 746.2209- posting the activity plan and 746.1205(a)(2)- Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for.  The operation was cited 3 times for not posting the activity plan. The operation was cited 2 times for caregivers not knowing how many children they are responsible for. The director is failing to maintain the operation within the compliance of the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))
